title: Gene Krupa and Benny Goodman's impact on drummers
summary: Krupa broke down traditions and helped drum equipment sales grow through his association with Goodman.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: I'll save my dear friend Gene Krupa for later. His part in the drumming world is a legend in itself -- not only as a playing artist, but in the breaking down of old traditions and the drum's importance in bands. The huge growth of drum equipment and sales is an outgrowth of

his association with Benny Goodman. Benny Goodman's entrance into the jazz picture from '35 on, I only mention this -- not to deviate from my personal story, but because all of us drummers in the jazz era were affected in some way of another by his predominance. A legend in his time, without peer.
